resolution: Fixed the startup timer printing a garbage negative total (-1782148114941ms). Root cause: startupTimer.ts re-resolved the clock per call via performance.now() ?? Date.now(); at the earliest module-eval performance.now was not yet installed so t0 fell back to Date.now() (epoch ms ~1.78e12), but later marks got performance.now() (small monotonic ms) — subtracting the two clocks produced the huge negative. Fix: pick ONE source at module load (use performance.now only if it is a function then, else Date.now for every mark including t0) so all marks share a clock. Boot spans are 100s of ms so Date.now 1ms resolution is fine. Verified transforms via tools/esbuild. Not committed.
